title: They are super easy to set up, but not long enough
text: They are super easy to set up, but not long enough. I saw those camping at another site and was totally looking forward to getting one myself. They are super easy to set up and you can hang up anything that needs drying, but the length is not long at all. You can't do much with them, since finding trees that are close enough are not always available and you barely can fit 2 beach towels on them. I was hoping the length would be much longer or you can stretch it longer.
